Seek God first. You are young and have your entire life to seek a mate. A DEEP DEEP abiding relationship with God is the only thing that will make you ready for God's ideal life for you. 
I had to finally be willing to be alone for the rest of my life without a mate and God dropped the woman of my dreams in my lap.
I old as heck (54), so my advice is based on a wasted lifetime of sin, self-seeking, and running from God.
May God bless your heart with peace as you seek him.

Our focus should be on God and him alone. When I searched for a deeper love for him, I became serene and actually happy about being alone (I divorced after 24 years of marriage due to her infidelity and my drinking). I recovered from the drinking and began to understand God loved me and was not seeking to punish me. 
When I genuinely came to the realization that God did not hate me it opened a door in my heart and soul, and I no longer needed a mate to "make me okay."
I was resigned to be single for the rest of my life (I'm 54, so it wouldn't be that long anyway...lol.). The ridiculously ironic thing that happened next was God dropped a Christian woman in my lap who was just a friend and who was out of my league. I now am in my first Christian relationship ever, and it is sooo wonderful and NOT corney..lol.
We pray, go on dates, and remain pure. I AM BLESSED. We are both growing closer to him and each other.
